params.prompt:
Create a production sprite sheet for the existing 2D STARBIT game, not concept art. EXACTLY NINE separate assets in a strict equally spaced 3 columns by 3 rows grid, read row-major. Canvas square with TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. Each asset must be isolated completely in its own cell, with at least 9 percent of the cell width of fully transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides. No object crosses cell boundaries. No grid lines, no labels, no letters, no cast shadow on the canvas, no fog or broad glows. Each whole silhouette including tiny tips must fit inside its cell. Center each object. Reference 1 defines the closest existing object category and its painted shapes; reference 2 defines the existing foreground outline thickness and material rendering; reference 3 is the actual target environment and only defines palette and world setting. Do not copy scenes or characters from references. Match STARBIT's hand-painted soft-volume rounded 2D cartoon sprites, colored dark teal/brown outlines, soft warm upper-left highlights, readable simplified details, not 3D, not pixel art, not flat vector. Strict side-view platformer perspective with only a LITTLE of top faces visible. Honey-brown timber, ochre stones, lime moss and grass, turquoise copper fittings, little cream flowers. All nine objects must belong to this SAME visual set. Sprite contents in exact row-major order:
1. one wide horizontal playable platform, about 3:1 width to height, perfectly level continuous top across the central 85 percent; no tall plants on walking surface.
2. one short horizontal ledge with flat top, 2:1 width to height.
3. a separate thin wide lift deck, 4:1 width to height, flat top; no ropes, no posts, no overhead structure.
4. a separate horizontal lift overhead header with two small pulleys; no ropes, no lift deck, no posts.
5. a low horizontal pressure plate with inset turquoise center button, no tall structure.
6. one standalone closed vertical barred shutter panel, no outer frame.
7. prickly bramble patch.
8. one cracked horizontal platform, perfectly flat walking top with clearly visible cracks, still intact.
9. old mossy winch with a clean circular empty gear socket.
Do not add extra unrelated objects. Mechanical parts are designed as separately movable components, never combine them. Make solid clean silhouettes, with no blurred halos.
